player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Raayaayu la '{symbol}'.
Wàññi mooy ginaale ñaar-ak-benn ci saa yu popp, ci kaw-kaw, ci suufu-saal, mbaa ci dig.
Bu la ñaar-ak-benn ci saa, la DOOTE.
Bindal saa jëfandikoo fòrmula '[4]' ngir sàkk sa raayaayu ci sélül 4.
Nga ngone jàngoro {player_id}, yaa '{symbol}' te sa xarit la '{opponent_symbol}'.

outcome.loss: Jëfandikukat {player_id} dafa ñàkk ndax mu matal benn yoon!
outcome.draw: Dafa am benn, kenn du ñàkk.
